result.topic_en: Tabulated induction observations with the circuit chain open ('Kette offen') and closed ('Kette geschlossen'), giving observation numbers, times, scale readings, their differences as logarithms, group means, and a recapitulation of the derived values.

methods.what: Common logarithms of the second scale reading (differences) tabulated for each observation
Averaging the logarithms of groups of four successive observations
Difference of group means between the two groups (scaled), giving a decrement value per interval
Recapitulation listing the derived values against the mid-epoch observation numbers, alternating open/closed circuit
